stemMd: A menu offers 4 soups and 5 mains. A meal consists of one soup and one main, except one particular pairing is unavailable. How many meals are possible?
explanationMd: The unrestricted product is $4\times5=20$. Exactly one pair is forbidden, so subtract one. Neither component is prohibited with every partner.

distractorRationale.a: Adds the categories and subtracts one.
distractorRationale.b: Removes each component rather than only their joint pairing.
